caption:
On this day, November 4, 1922… one single step changed Egypt's history 🇪🇬

In the Valley of the Kings, beneath the remains of ancient workers' huts, Howard Carter's team uncovered the first step of a staircase leading to the tomb of Tutankhamun.

Three weeks later, Carter peered through a small hole by candlelight. Asked "Can you see anything?", he answered: "Yes… wonderful things."

The tomb was almost intact: more than 5,000 objects, and around 10 years to clear and record them all.

Today, the whole collection is in one place: the Grand Egyptian Museum.
